description: Refine app/(tabs)/index.tsx (main dashboard) and src/components/planner/LineChart.tsx. Changes: page subtitle text, tab bar active treatment (accentBlue text + subtle pill), remove ALL-CAPS from s.sectionTitle style, update all section heading string literals to sentence case, restructure BestHoursChartRN (period display with time range + peak hour, remove '% of total' from breakdown), simplify TopicBalanceRN per-topic rows (remove completion rate bar and avg duration), add sparse data message in StatisticsTab, reduce card border widths, update spacing, improve today's dot in LineChart. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: 1. Ensure branch 'feat/dashboard-ui-refinement' is checked out. FEAT-001 must be committed first (its commit will be in git log).

2. Open app/(tabs)/index.tsx. Read the FULL file before making any change — it is large (~1200 lines). Pay careful attention to the s = StyleSheet.create({}) block and the st = StyleSheet.create({}) block (they are separate).
3. Change the page subtitle text in DashboardScreen JSX: 'Your productivity overview' -> 'Your productivity at a glance'.

4. Change the tab bar active treatment in DashboardScreen's TABS.map: (a) Change active tab label color from tokens.textPrimary to tokens.accentBlue. (b) Change the active pill inline background from tokens.bgSecondary to tokens.accentPrimaryLight. Keep all other tab bar logic (accessibility, icon colors, etc.) unchanged.

5. Modify s.sectionTitle in the s = StyleSheet.create({}) block: remove textTransform:'uppercase', change fontWeight '700'->'600', remove letterSpacing:0.7, change fontSize 11->13, add lineHeight:20. IMPORTANT: do NOT change s.statLabel or s.statCardLabel — those keep their uppercase letterSpacing styling for TODAY/STREAK/TIME INVESTED/COMPLETED labels.

6. Update string literals in BestHoursChartRN: change the sectionTitle text 'Best Hours' -> 'Most productive time'. Add periodTimeRanges mapping const at the top of BestHoursChartRN: { morning: '6 AM – 12 PM', afternoon: '12 PM – 6 PM', evening: '6 PM – 12 AM', night: '12 AM – 6 AM' }. Restructure bhPeriodBox: (a) Remove the bhPeriodLabel Text element ('Most Productive — all time'). (b) Capitalize the mostProductivePeriod value before display. (c) Add a bhPeriodRange Text below the bhPeriodValue showing periodTimeRanges[mostProductivePeriod]. (d) Change peak hours display to show only the single top peak hour as 'Peak activity: {h} {AM/PM}'. Remove the bhChartSub Text element ('Based on all completed tasks'). In the period breakdown map, remove the bhPeriodPct Text element (the '% of total' line) from each bhPeriodCell.

7. Update StatisticsTab: (a) Change the 30-day chart heading text 'TASKS COMPLETED (LAST 30 DAYS)' -> 'Tasks completed'. (b) Change its inline color from tokens.textMuted to tokens.textSecondary. (c) Add a sparse data check: const activePoints = chartData30Days.filter((d: any) => d.count > 0).length; if activePoints < 5, render a muted italic Text with style s.sparseTrendMsg above the LineChart, showing 'Complete a few more tasks to see your productivity trend.'

8. Update ActivityTab string literals (both use s.sectionTitle): (a) 'LAST 7 DAYS' -> 'Last 7 days'. (b) 'RECENT ACTIVITY' -> 'Recent activity'. Change both inline colors from tokens.textMuted to tokens.textSecondary.

9. Simplify TopicBalanceRN per-topic rows: (a) In the tbTopics map, change tbTopicMeta text to '{topic.taskCount} task{plural} · {fmtDuration(topic.totalTime)}' — remove the ' · avg task {fmtDuration(topic.avgDuration)}' part. (b) Remove the entire tbProgressRow block (containing tbProgressTrack, tbProgressFill, tbRatePct, tbRateCount) from each topic row. (c) Remove the rateColor variable declaration (now unused). (d) Check if tbSuggestions/tbBalanced blocks are present — if so, remove them.

10. Modify style keys in s = StyleSheet.create({}): (a) card.borderWidth: 1 -> StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. (b) statBar.borderWidth: 1 -> StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. (c) progressCard.borderWidth: 1 -> StyleSheet.hairlineWidth. (d) cardWrapper.marginBottom: 14 -> 16. (e) analyticsHeading.marginTop: 4 -> 24.

11. Add new style keys to s = StyleSheet.create({}): sparseTrendMsg: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 18, textAlign: 'center', marginBottom: 8, fontStyle: 'italic' }. Add bhPeriodRange: { fontSize: 11, lineHeight: 16, marginTop: 2 }.

12. Open src/components/planner/LineChart.tsx. In the WebLineChart component's dot-rendering map, make today's dot (last index) visually distinct: change radius logic to 'const isToday = i === (data?.length ?? 1) - 1; const r = isHover ? 6 : isToday ? 4 : hasData ? 2.5 : 1.5'. Change opacity to: 'opacity: isHover ? 1 : (isToday || hasData) ? 1 : 0.35'.

13. In LineChart.tsx main export function, add sparse data detection: 'const activeCount = (data ?? []).filter(d => d.count > 0).length; const showSparseTip = activeCount < 5'. Wrap the platform chart return in a View and conditionally add a Text below when showSparseTip is true, using style native.sparseTip and color tokens.textMuted. Add sparseTip style to the native StyleSheet: { fontSize: 12, lineHeight: 18, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 8, fontStyle: 'italic' }.

14. Run 'npx tsc --noEmit' from the workspace root /Users/parteek.kumar/Dev/common-tasks/daily-planner. Fix any TypeScript errors. Common issues to watch for: (a) 'as any' casts may need to be added/maintained for the sparse chartData30Days filter since it has type any[]. (b) Ensure bhPeriodRange is added to s StyleSheet if referenced in JSX. (c) Ensure the View wrapper in LineChart main return doesn't break existing callers.
15. Run 'npx vitest --run' from the workspace root. All tests must pass.

16. Stage the changed files: 'git add app/(tabs)/index.tsx src/components/planner/LineChart.tsx'. Commit: 'git commit -m "refactor(dashboard): refine index.tsx tab bar, headings, BestHours, TopicBalance, LineChart"'. Record commit hash in findings.
